# External Fuse

External deterministic fuse for AI-agent effects.

External Fuse does not stop an agent itself. It provides an externally observable fuse state that can be used to control whether an effect is allowed to proceed.

## State

A fuse has one of two states:

- INTACT
- BLOWN

## Base URL

https://external-fuse.onrender.com

## Typical flow

1. POST /provision to create a new fuse and obtain its fuse_id.
2. Use the returned fuse_id in place of {fuse_id}.
3. GET /fuse/{fuse_id} to read the current state.
4. POST /fuse/{fuse_id}/trip to change an INTACT fuse to BLOWN.

Do not send the literal string {fuse_id}. Replace it with the UUID returned by /provision.

## Endpoints

### POST /provision

Creates a new fuse in INTACT state.

Price: 0.001 USDC via x402.

No request body is required. Payment is supplied through the x402 payment header.

Returns a fuse_id identifying the newly provisioned fuse.

### GET /fuse/{fuse_id}

Reads the current state of a fuse.

Price: Free.

fuse_id must be the UUID of a provisioned fuse.

The state is INTACT or BLOWN.

### POST /fuse/{fuse_id}/trip

Trips an INTACT fuse to BLOWN.

Price: 0.005 USDC via x402 when the fuse is INTACT.

If the fuse is already BLOWN, the endpoint returns 200 without requiring payment.

If the fuse does not exist, the endpoint returns 404 without requiring payment.

## Discovery

OpenAPI:
https://external-fuse.onrender.com/openapi.json

Health:
https://external-fuse.onrender.com/health

## Payment

Protocol: x402

Inspect the 402 response and OpenAPI payment metadata for the current payment requirements before paying.
